start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '隆安县,南宁市' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E9%9A%86%E5%AE%89%E5%8E%BF%2C%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%81%E5%B8%82) -- returned the Long'an county-seat place node; multiple independent sources (finance.sina.com.cn, nationalee.com, and a bibenet.com procurement listing) name '隆安分输站' as a specific facility but do not give a finer address, so this is a county-level fallback.

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '武鸣区,南宁市' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%AD%A6%E9%B8%A3%E5%8C%BA%2C%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%81%E5%B8%82) -- returned the Wuming district-seat place node; district-level fallback, same reasoning as the start point.

corridor_notes: A 2025-02-28 Sina Finance article (re-syndicated from a Guangxi Energy Group / Guangtou Pipe Network release, and matching the nationalee.com press release already cited by GEM) states: '隆安—武鸣天然气支线管道工程...管道起自国家管网西二线南宁-百色支线5#阀室，新建管道50公里、2座分输站和1座阀室' (the Long'an-Wuming gas branch pipeline originates at Valve Chamber #5 on PipeChina's West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2, Nanning-Baise branch; newly built 50 km of pipe, 2 distribution stations and 1 monitoring valve chamber) and names the two stations explicitly: '沿线设置分输站2座（隆安分输站、武鸣分输站）' (Long'an distribution station and Wuming distribution station). Design specs: horizontal length 49.46km, D323.9mm, 6.3MPa design pressure, design throughput 4.4e8 Nm3/a (0.44 bcm/y) -- all consistent with GEM's recorded values. '隆安分输站顺利投产，武鸣分输站成功进气' (Long'an station commissioned, Wuming station received gas) as of the 2025-03 commissioning. Neither source gives the exact township/village for either station beyond the county/district name.
researcher_notes: Builds on the pilot pass, which flagged FuelSource misattribution (should be West-East Line 2 Nanning-Baise branch, not Sino-Myanmar) and a segment_name transcription slip ('Longming-Wu'an' should be 'Long'an-Wuming') -- both confirmed again here via a second, independently-published outlet (finance.sina.com.cn, matching the nationalee.com wire story almost verbatim, still counts only as corroborating republication per the corroboration rule, not a second independent source). This second fetch additionally surfaced the exact station names (隆安分输站, 武鸣分输站) and the tie-in point (5# valve chamber on West-East Line 2's Nanning-Baise branch), which the pilot pass's single source did not spell out. A bibenet.com procurement notice ('公路一期涉及横县支线与上林至横县高速公路交叉改线工程和隆安-武鸣支线接驳国家管网南百线改扩建工程隆安分输站段线路工程施工') independently confirms the project name and the Long'an-station tie-in construction scope but returned HTTP 403 on fetch attempts, so it was not used as a ref, only as supporting context.
